svg.text: BRIDGES — sheet A: the Long Bridge, the Lotus Pond humpback, the pink viaduct

Night model sheet, round 1. Glossy pearl-white marble with gold fractal inlay; rose stone; neon footstep ripples (green → blue → purple → yellow → pink). Figures are veiled and faceless; finials are stars or lotus buds. Metres throughout.
A1 · Long Bridge — two-tier arch module (side elevation, 2 of 40 bays) + deck plan
Sources: U95 U138 U145 U401 (two-tier round-arch arcade, piers, cutwaters) · U369 (pilasters to parapet) · U77 U401 (rail) · bridge-design.md §2–5
BUILD: one 20 m bay = Blender mesh baked to ~400 tris + normal/AO; instanced ×40 (2 draw calls); reflection = mirrored low copy
SIZE: bay 20 m · deck +16 m above lake · lower arch span 16.4 m · upper arches 8 m · pier 3.6 m thick, cutwater 1.5 m
upper tier: 2 cusped arches per bay,
and drops as a ring on the lake
A2 · Pier with cutwater + lotus lanterns
Sources: U95 U369 (pointed cutwaters) · U258 U259 (floating candles) · U283 (lotus-bud finials) · U29 U108 (branch lace)
BUILD: pier = part of bay mesh; lotus lanterns = 1 instanced mesh (≈60 tris) + emissive, bob shader; rosette = normal map + line mask
SIZE: pier 3.6 × 14 m + noses 3 m · cutwater to +5.2 m, cap to +7.6 m · lantern Ø0.9 m
SIDE (14 m pier face, Koch rosette 6 m)
PLAN at water: 16 lotus lanterns, drifting 0.2 m/s round the pier
A3 · Long Bridge railing module — pierced tracery panel + post (close-up, 4 m)
Sources: U77 (twin lancets + cusped roundels, square newels) · U401 (interlaced arcade) · U283 U284 (girih star roundel) · U261 U351 (plinth) · U128 (rail line)
BUILD: Blender full-detail module (≈38k tris) baked to a ~300-tri card: alpha-cutout + normal + AO; instanced ×400 (3 draw calls)
SIZE: post 0.6 × 0.6 × 1.5 m + lantern 0.8 m · panel 3.4 × 1.1 m, ≈65% open · plinth 0.25 m · rail 0.3 m wide
girih 8-point star roundel, gold ring moulding
enclosing arch over twin lancets + quatrefoil (U77)
ogee handrail, gold crown line = ripple track
• render panel is ~35% open — solid slab with holes;
carve thin bars (55 mm) so the lake reads through (65%)
• add the twin-lancet arches + mouchettes from U77
• lantern: keep crystal + gold cap, add star finial
Sources: U343 (panelled octagonal base, ogee moulding, plaque, twin arms) · U155 (acanthus candelabra) · U77 U403 (lantern heads) · bridge-design §4
BUILD: Blender mesh ≈600 tris, 1 material + emissive crystal; instanced ≈100; real light only on every 4th, rest bloom
SIZE: 4 m above the 1.5 m post (5.7 m over the deck) · arms span 1.5 m · crystals pink-white #ffd6f0
A5 · Bridge pavilion (Photo Pavilion at 550 m)
Sources: U279 U280 (chhatri domes, chhajja eaves, lit arcades) · U283 (cusped arches) · U284 (gold ring columns, strapwork) · U292 (hexagram jali)
BUILD: Blender mesh ≈3k tris; glass dome = transmissive-look emissive shader with gold rib mesh; jali = alpha-cutout cards; basin uses deck ripple shader
SIZE: octagon 18 m across · columns 6 m · dome Ø10 m · finial tip +21 m above the deck
glass dome Ø10 m, 16 gold ribs,
seat ring · basin · jali on 4 sides
A6 · Lotus Pond humpback bridge (arrival, on the straight approach)
Sources: U53 U62 (humpback form, bud-capped posts) · U251 (archivolt, keystone, coping) · U152 (balustraded bridge) · U351 U261 (vase balusters) · U258 U259 U292 (lotus pond, candles)
BUILD: Blender mesh ≈2.5k tris (arches+balustrade baked to normal map); balusters instanced; lotus + candles instanced emissive; pond = water shader
SIZE: 80 m long × 18 m wide · deck +2.5 m at the ends → +7.5 m at the crown over the pond (r 32 m) · main arch 22 m
white vase balustrade, gold bullnose rail
newel with lotus-bud cap + lantern (U62 bud caps)
A7 · Pink arched viaduct — Grand Approach over the lake to the stair-foot pool
Sources: U278 (rose Mughal viaduct: arches in rectangular frames, jali parapet) · U280 U279 (guldasta turrets, chhatri tops) · U283 (cusped arches) · U401 (two-tier arcade) · U95 (piers in water)
BUILD: bay = Blender mesh ≈900 tris + normal map, lower piers stretch with ground height; jali parapet alpha-cutout; 1 warm glow card under each arch
SIZE: 26 m bays × ~23 bays · 18 m wide · deck rises +34 → +90 m over 600 m (9.4%) · gallery tier 7 m constant, lower arches grow
tall cusped Mughal arch in a rectangular
guldasta turret with lotus dome on every pier
gallery tier: 3 cusped arches per bay (U278)
jali parapet (U278) + iron lamp every 13 m
DETAIL · gallery arch, spandrel, cornice, jali parapet, guldasta
